rows.title: Effectiveness and safety of cannabidiol in adult patients with epilepsy: A multicenter, retrospective study.
rows.evidence_boundary: This is a retrospective observational study in adults with severe epilepsy syndromes receiving adjunctive CBD; it cannot establish causality and should not be generalized to non-epilepsy CBD use.

rows.title: Repeated whole-body inhalation of cannabidiol vapor induces progressive pulmonary inflammatory and vascular remodeling without systemic toxicity in Sprague-Dawley rats.
rows.evidence_boundary: Repeated inhaled-CBD findings are from rats and are route-specific; they cannot establish human respiratory risk or safety for oral or other CBD formulations.

rows.title: Safety of synthetic cannabidiol as a novel food pursuant to regulation (EU) 2015/2283.
rows.evidence_boundary: The EFSA opinion applies to a defined synthetic CBD product, proposed 2 mg/day use, and specified adult population; safety with concomitant medications was not established.

rows.title: Comparative in vitro safety assessments of synthetized and plant-derived cannabidiol (CBD), and pharmacokinetics of synthetized CBD: evidence of similar toxicological profiles and accumulation upon repeated oral administration.
rows.evidence_boundary: The comparison combines in vitro toxicology with rat pharmacokinetics; source-equivalence and accumulation findings require human confirmation and are formulation-specific.

rows.title: Modulation of spatial learning and memory by cannabinoid-estrogen interaction in an AD-like cognitive impairment: The role of cannabinoid receptors and BDNF protein.
rows.evidence_boundary: The study uses an ovariectomized AD-like rat model and marijuana extract with estradiol; it is mechanistic/preclinical and does not establish human cognitive benefit.
